2607.06531.title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
2607.06531.paper_summary: - Objective: Multimodal deep learning models in oncology are currently limited by monolithic designs that rigidly couple data ingestion, clinical routing, and artificial intelligence (AI) inference. To address this inflexibility, we propose the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a model-agnostic, post-hoc orchestration framework designed for scalable clinical decision support. - Methods: The LCA is mathematically formalized as a 7-tuple architecture grounded in the principle of Algorithmic Impermeability, ensuring the orchestration logic remains strictly independent of underlying black-box AI models. We introduce the Entry Theory, leveraging Geometric Deep Learning (GDL) to standardize multimodal patient data along distinct structural and medical axes. The system dynamically orchestrates data via a Cancer Switching Module and intentionally isolates the core AI execution from volatile hospital IT infrastructures by outputting a Standardized Intermediate Payload (SIP). - Results: A Proof of Concept (PoC) validated the orchestration logic across four technical scenarios. The framework executed a nominal flow with negligible orchestration overhead. It empirically demonstrated algorithmic impermeability by maintaining an invariant routing projection during AI model swaps, and it validated strict failure-safety by achieving a 100\% recall rate in generating targeted Supplementary Data Requests (SDR) under injected data anomalies. Multi-protocol execution capability was also successfully verified. - Conclusion: By structurally decoupling multimodal ingestion from feature inference, the LCA provides a highly adaptable and modular orchestration foundation. The SIP establishes a clear architectural boundary, natively setting the stage for downstream Electronic Medical Record (EMR) interoperability as an independent future paradigm.
2607.06531.paper_summary_zh:
- 目標：目前在腫瘤學中的多模態深度學習模型受到單一設計的限制，這種設計將數據攝取、臨床路由和人工智慧（AI）推斷緊密耦合。為了解決這種不靈活性，我們提出了大型癌症助手（LCA），這是一個與模型無關的後處理協調框架，旨在提供可擴展的臨床決策支持。<lb/>
- 方法：LCA 在數學上被形式化為一個基於算法不透過性原則的 7 元組架構，確保協調邏輯與底層黑箱 AI 模型保持嚴格獨立。我們引入了進入理論，利用幾何深度學習（GDL）來標準化多模態患者數據，沿著不同的結構和醫療軸進行標準化。該系統通過癌症切換模塊動態協調數據，並故意將核心 AI 執行與不穩定的醫院 IT 基礎設施隔離，通過輸出標準化中介有效載荷（SIP）。<lb/>
- 結果：概念驗證（PoC）驗證了四種技術場景中的協調邏輯。該框架執行了名義流，協調開銷微乎其微。它通過在 AI 模型切換期間保持不變的路由投影，實證展示了算法不透過性，並通過在注入數據異常的情況下生成目標補充數據請求（SDR）時達到 100\% 的召回率來驗證嚴格的故障安全性。多協議執行能力也成功驗證。<lb/>
- 結論：通過在結構上將多模態攝取與特徵推斷解耦，LCA 提供了一個高度適應性和模塊化的協調基礎。SIP 建立了一個明確的架構邊界，自然為下游電子病歷（EMR）互操作性設置了舞台，作為一個獨立的未來範式。
